relations: If the clothespin spiral remains undisturbed, upright pins keep their radial arrangement.
Green and cream arcs persist relative to white spokes when no collapse front passes.
The central S-loop stays connected to inner arcs while surrounding pins remain upright.
Left trigger stick and blue pieces stay near lower-left as the camera remains fixed.
caption: The video showcases a top-down view of an elaborate domino arrangement of upright clothespins laid out in a wide spiral on a light wooden floor. Most of the spiral and its radial spokes are white, while one upper arc is green and an inner arc pale cream, with a small S-shaped loop at the center. At the far left a separate short run of pins forms a straight line and a coiled loop, and a yellow trigger stick with a red tip rests near loose blue pieces at the lower-left. The camera and wood-grain background remain steady. The standing pins, colored arcs, and central loop remain in place, with no collapse front moving through the layout.
